build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run bridge:build && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: An offline field guide for your Stardew Valley saves
bundle.longDescription: Unofficial Stardew Valley companion with save analysis, an optional bundled game connection, farm and home design, saved storage maps, festival guides and optional public Steam achievement evidence.
